description: Lists domains that link to the competitors but not to the user's domain, ranked by domain rank. Use it to find outreach targets. It spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap is refused with an error saying so, and a cached answer from the last 7 days costs nothing. The agent never sees the key. Returns rows of the linking domain, its rank, and which competitors it links to.

competitors.description: Competitor domains without a scheme, such as ["rival.com", "other.example"]; 1 to 10.

domain.description: The user's domain without a scheme, such as "acme.example".

limit.description: The most linking domains to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

name: link_gap
title: Link gap
